body:
[ stdin# ]Our Revolution Logo

Peter Willis,

This weekend, Trump sent shockwaves across the world with a dangerous,
expletive-filled social media post. As Bernie called out, these unhinged
threats will only bring more bloodshed, trauma, and chaos – not just for
Iran, but for families in our communities and our service members abroad.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/36332?source=email-20240406&t=1011&akid=10498%2E5885482%2EVTyB-z ]Bernie tweet: One month after starting the war in Iran, this is the
statement of the President of the United States on Easter Sunday. These
are the ravings of a deranged and mentally unbalanced individual. Congress
has got to act NOW. End this war.

ENOUGH. Congress has the power – and the responsibility – to stop this
now. A War Powers Resolution to rein Trump in is picking up steam in the
House – but Congress needs to hear from ALL of us demanding it act to
FINALLY stop Trump’s war.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/36332?source=email-20240406&t=1012&akid=10498%2E5885482%2EVTyB-z ]Together, let’s stand with Bernie and make sure Congress hears our call
to action loud and clear while our representatives are back in their home
states on recess. Add your name – tell Congress: Stop Trump’s war on Iran
now!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/36332?source=email-20240406&t=1013&akid=10498%2E5885482%2EVTyB-z ]ADD YOUR NAME

Trump has no plan, just blustering threats that risk everything. His team
can’t even describe an endgame. Each reckless comment spikes global
tension, inflates costs at the pump, and increases the odds of retaliatory
violence here at home.

And let’s be clear: what Trump is threatening to do is commit war crimes.
He is openly talking about hitting bridges, power plants, desalination
stations, and more with one goal: inflicting widespread suffering on
Iran’s 93 million people.

As Trump makes war, deaths, and suffering into a sick game, our
communities are paying the price too. Gas prices have shot above $4 a
gallon, making it even harder for working families to make ends meet.
Headlines about "boots on the ground" are sowing terror and anxiety among
military families.

Lawmakers in both parties are worried. Americans – regardless of party –
don’t want another endless war in the Middle East, and Congress is feeling
the pressure. Democratic leaders believe they have the votes to finally
rein Trump in with this War Powers Resolution. But they need to hear a
tidal wave of support from us – right now, while they’re home for spring
recess, listening to grassroots pressure.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/36332?source=email-20240406&t=1014&akid=10498%2E5885482%2EVTyB-z ]Headline: Winds shift in support of resolution to end Trump's war with
Iran.

Trump thinks he can run roughshod over Congress and public will. Let’s
show him he’s wrong.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/36332?source=email-20240406&t=1015&akid=10498%2E5885482%2EVTyB-z ]Add your name right now to stand with Bernie and tell Congress to stop
Trump’s deranged escalation of this war, NOW!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/36332?source=email-20240406&t=1016&akid=10498%2E5885482%2EVTyB-z ]ADD YOUR NAME

When we organize, we win,

Our Revolution

The United States has the worst maternal mortality rate in the developed world. This rate is only rising, and it’s driven by far higher mortality rates among Black mothers and birthing people of color.
**Today, Black women are three to four times more likely than white women to die from pregnancy-related complications. These alarming statistics are an urgent call to action that we have a responsibility to answer.**
The Momnibus will finally reverse the rising trend of maternal mortality, save moms' lives, and close racial and ethnic disparities in maternal health outcomes.
Too many families have lost mothers, daughters, and sisters to our nation’s maternal health crisis — and the Momnibus is the solution. _Moms can’t wait_ , and it’s time for Congress to step up and finally pass this critical legislation.
[_**Our mothers deserve better, and their lives are at stake. I need everyone on this team to stand with me at this moment. Please split a contribution of any amount between Janelle Bynum and me to help me get this critical legislation across the finish line >>>**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/128919171/612704437/-1097027527?amount=25&refcode=email_040626_underwood&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY3MjEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzJhYjdjYTAtZjIzMS1mMTExLTlhNDgtMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Gg4nsQrXlrAWmn088c_58lrE6-fn_2BTJD01KywtVCI=)

The _Protecting Moms Who Served Act_ was signed into law in 2021 and is already making a difference. But this crisis demands more action. That’s why I am asking for support to amplify my call for passage of the entire _Momnibus_ — all 14 bills that offer a comprehensive solution to tackle the maternal health crisis head-on.
Investing in the social determinants of health, community-based organizations, and building a diverse workforce so that moms can work with providers of their choice — no matter their zip code — is how we solve this crisis. Your support is essential to making this vision a reality.
_Momentum is building for this crucial legislation, and moms can’t wait. We need as many voices as possible to make a meaningful impact._

| | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

We proved that this district is not locked down -- that it's not owned by any party or any politician. | But none of that matters if we don't finish strong. Right now, the other side is spending everything they've got to dominate these final 24 hours -- ads, turnout, last-minute messaging to push their voters across the finish line. And I'll be blunt: If we don 't have the resources to respond, they will overpower us at the exact moment this election is decided. That's what's keeping me up tonight. Because this race is winnable. But only if we show up -- right now. ~~ ~~ ~~ There is no "later" anymore. This is it. We either step up right now -- or we wake up the day after wishing we had done more. I'm all in. And before this election is over in just 24 hours, I'm asking you to be all in with me. Shawn Harris | ~~ "Facebook" ~ "X" \[BLUESKY\] "Bluesky" PAID FOR BY SHAWN FOR GEORGIA

body:
Seth is in Congress to fight for the middle class and those working hard to join it. Peter, let’s cut through the noise.

While the politicians in D.C. point fingers at each other, the reality for people in Rhode Island is much simpler, and much more frustrating. You see it every time you swipe your card at the grocery store or open a utility bill. _Prices are high, and they’re staying there._

But here is the part that often gets left out of the conversation: **At the exact same time people are being squeezed, the corporations gouging people are reporting the highest profit margins in decades. And some politicians are letting it happen.**

Right now, Big Oil is raking in billions in profit while families can’t afford to keep the heat on or fill up their tanks. Drug companies continue to pad their bottom lines while people are forced to ration medication.

I didn’t go to Washington to protect the status quo or to offer excuses for why things can’t change. I’m fighting for Rhode Islanders because I know we can’t let corporate interests dictate the rules of our economy. [If you’re with me, please chip in so I can keep fighting back against this kind of corruption.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/128921417/612711754/1196974343?amount=10&source=EM_NBI_SM_20260406_FR_pricegouging_0_3MO_SethMagaziner_NA_NA_NA&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYzc3NmE5OC1mOTMxLWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3eVBybvwE_qIx63EhPYmwN8NNv4bfvBnHkn7dLc1MAE=)

This isn't merely an argument over economics; it’s a question of fundamental fairness. We have to do better, and with your support, I’m going to keep fighting until we do.

Thank you,

Seth

clean_body: Seth is in Congress to fight for the middle class and those working hard to join it. If you’d like to unsubscribe, | | Peter, let’s cut through the noise. While the politicians in D.C. point fingers at each other, the reality for people in Rhode Island is much simpler, and much more frustrating. You see it every time you swipe your card at the grocery store or open a utility bill. Prices are high, and they’re staying there. But here is the part that often gets left out of the conversation: At the exact same time people are being squeezed, the corporations gouging people are reporting the highest profit margins in decades. And some politicians are letting it happen. Right now, Big Oil is raking in billions in profit while families can’t afford to keep the heat on or fill up their tanks. Drug companies continue to pad their bottom lines while people are forced to ration medication. I didn’t go to Washington to protect the status quo or to offer excuses for why things can’t change. I’m fighting for Rhode Islanders because I know we can’t let corporate interests dictate the rules of our economy. = This isn't merely an argument over economics; it’s a question of fundamental fairness. We have to do better, and with your support, I’m going to keep fighting until we do. I was there on January 6 -- badge on, on the line -- as a Capitol Police officer trying to hold back a mob incited by the President of the United States.
I saw what happens when people in power forget who they're supposed to serve. I saw the ego. The cowardice. The consequences.
**That 's why I'm running for Congress.**
I don't care about respectability politics. I'm not interested in going along to get along.
Here's what I _am_ interested in:
* Defending voting rights
* Protecting reproductive rights
* Lowering prescription drug costs
* Fixing our broken immigration system

After 16 years on the Capitol Police force, I know what this fight looks like up close. And I know what's at stake if we lose.
But winning this race won't be easy.
**One of my opponents is reporting an average contribution of $612. Mine is $18.81.**
I'm proud of that number. It means our movement is built on real people -- not big checks from a handful of donors. But it also means every time one person writes my opponent a four-figure check, I'm counting on dozens of grassroots supporters to step up and match it.
We're working toward 5,000 new donations this week. If you've been thinking about jumping in, now is the time.

I spent my years defending the Capitol. Now I want to serve in it -- for the people of Maryland's 5th District, and for everyone who believes we can't afford to hand the House back to MAGA.
Together,
Harry

| Peter, I'll be honest with you. I've been watching the debate over the SAVE America Act in Washington — and while I'm cheering for it to pass, I've been in this fight long enough to know something most people won't say: **We cannot afford to wait on Washington to save our elections.** While politicians debate, the Democrat ground game does not stop. Their voter registration staffers are at their tables right now. Their ballot chasers are making their calls. Their door knockers are hitting their lists. _And if we are not doing the same thing — right now — we are falling behind._ **I know this because I've lived it.** In 2024, my team spent over a year embedded on the ground in Pennsylvania before Election Day. We helped register hundreds of thousands of new Republican voters. We chased down every outstanding mail-in ballot we legally could. We drove voters to the polls on Election Day. **That is why Pennsylvania went red.** Not because of any law. Not because of any court ruling. Because of boots on the ground, day after day, doing the unglamorous, exhausting, absolutely essential work of grassroots organizing.

| | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

So I’m humbly asking: Will you chip in a split donation of $50, $30, or even $15 between Resist Reclaim Rebuild and my campaign right now so we can hit our end of quarter goals? >> [] [] HELP ME DEFEAT LINDSEY GRAHAM! >> [] Let me introduce myself. I’ve spent nearly 20 years serving my community as a pediatrician, treating everything from asthma and violent trauma to the emotional toll of growing up in poverty. I’ve seen what bad policy does to good families — and I’ve seen kids suffer because people like Lindsey Graham would rather protect their own power than protect children. In 2022, after 15 years of working in hospitals, I ran for Congress because I knew our kids needed a voice in Washington. I lost — and I told my oldest daughter I wouldn’t run again. But then Trump’s chaos came back. And Lindsey Graham? He cheered. The truth is, I’m scared. And I’m angry. And I’m done waiting. So I’m stepping up — because our kids, and this country can’t afford another six years of Lindsey Graham. I’m building a people-powered campaign to flip South Carolina and give kids the voice they deserve. And I need your help. [] CHIP IN TO STOP MAGA EXTREMISM!>> [] Thank you for believing in this campaign, Dr. Annie Andrews Resist Reclaim Rebuild is an organization committed to helping Democrats win up and down the ballot, nationwide. [1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

In case you missed it, Justice Democrats proudly endorsed veteran and
surgeon Dr. Adam Hamawy in this June’s competitive Democratic primary race
for Congress in New Jersey’s 12th district.

His mission is clear: Fund healthcare, not bombs. Abolish ICE. Unrig our
economy.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260406-ah.USkrd1&refcode=em20260406-37644&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=37644%2E1203867%2EJVFiBY ]A post on X from @joeymdfox: 'News: @JusticeDems, a group closely tied
to Congress’s most prominent progressives, is adding @HamawyForNJ to its
2026 slate. An endorsement that sharpens NJ-12 battle lines and invites
more nat’l attention to a race that’s so far flown under the radar.'

Our endorsement last week helped thrust NJ-12 into the national spotlight,
putting this district at the center of a much larger fight over the future
of the Democratic Party.

What was once a race flying under the radar is now a battleground for
bold, people-first leadership — and for the kind of progressive vision
voters want this party to embrace.

But with that spotlight comes higher stakes. National attention means more
outside money, more outside pressure, and more attempts to hold back the
kind of change that Dr. Adam represents.

Other candidates in this race may call themselves “progressive,” but Dr.
Adam’s unwavering support for Palestinian liberation, opposition to more
forever wars, and clear vision to take on corporate and billionaire greed
stands unmatched. He was one of the few Americans to travel to Gaza and
provide voluntary medical care while witnessing the true devastation of
Israel’s genocide. Meanwhile, one of his top opponents was previously
backed by the Democratic Majority for Israel (DMFI), a Super PAC closely
aligned with AIPAC, just two years ago.

The AIPAC network and Democratic establishment will no doubt try to
install a corporate-backed, pro-war candidate in this seat to maintain the
status quo.

Justice Democrats now to help us win this primary on June 2!

Patriot, When lives are on the line, either here in America or in some place halfway around the planet, the difference-maker is often one simple thing – _**preparation.**_ And right now, 35 dedicated candidates are about to find out if they’re prepared to do what’s necessary when it matters most. From April 9–13, Heroes for Humanity is running its next INDOC – a rigorous Assessment & Selection and Basic Operator Training program. **This is how we identify, equip, and send out the next wave of operators ready to evacuate Americans from war-torn areas, rescue trafficking victims, deliver aid in disaster zones, and bring the hope of Christ to those who feel completely abandoned.** Last Indoc, 22 candidates pushed through with zero quitters. The classroom taught them the "why." The physical training proved they have the "will." From before sunrise to long after sundown, these candidates were tested, trained, and transformed – learning what it truly means to be elite volunteers who operate with excellence in the name of Christ. These graduates are the embodiment of the truth that **faith without works is dead** , and overnight our mission got exponentially stronger. **That’s exactly why we’re coming to you today, humbly but urgently. Before our next Indoc begins on April 9th, we are fighting to raise $25,000 to fully fund their training, travel, gear, lodging and operational preparation. Time is short, but we believe it’s possible.** [**Will you send in a tax-deductible contribution to help ensure we can send fully prepared and equipped teams into the fight?**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=9ced05dccad54948a523e2e3aba062a4&_e=driNpJ4mDvv-ffvZUMyxyiSpR_riIGw2tGIfMaSTrTyUNnXK-SeQgtPskKHgVM4G_XqBD4cJdvUaJHVC6oi1DRXZ-jGBZKT-SaHHLqynyZIeOQMU_oWWZFEweNyABB-QQyGdp-e_Pftw7jgS7b2KytLFWO-TR93Ie0VexJODJU-GfBRWzOZFEPpXrDvsO3Bg9hTkNvlBE-JUXKekGO-5HeWS_eKiwNzEsx5diSE3Vv5EATHVEardu4klq7k0WNdJTXRs9j9dfVD798kS6TtYw8coc9gQQf9UpbkEhwDf7XtOMcjHYrx20GAz880oZLeOudt7QfAUV8GeIE8-F0iqyqdIi2MdgYgyGaOHHV7L0GSZi2V4_ZvPmsD2v6f2VqHV9ZWViqzTSgiPKgBGWKpRSA9ltorp5qRZTOuMUhjQ8vOMlTp5zXb2XmmAYBN0nn3XVUvFrE_0VsYFEs-vKQBnBF_O2CeHuXJOvLTGTHgeUrNdSz51sXiJDxuqiEsQ1JVz-2zAqVNAs9kp0nwXZyknRQteUvdUFpjGl27jYea2NUrkws-0u1V5YdkFNAU6WGSdfRplGwUy_BaQfEh0zmbrEjnAxQ4vlbi5T0nGfd56Jq0%3D)

When we say “into the fight,” let me explain exactly what that means... **It means the 12-year-old girl trapped for 45 days under a bridge in a California homeless encampment** — drugged, raped, and forced into prostitution. On day 46, our team located her, pulled her to safety, stayed with her, provided food and medical care, and prayed until she could believe her life still had value. “Into the fight” means **evacuating the 33 families and 155 other individuals from the Middle East** when the war started in Iran. It means **locating and providing safe houses, logistics, and asylum for 54 persecuted Christian families in China.** And right now, it means **providing critical humanitarian and medical aid to the people of Oahu** who've been devastated by floods. Remember this – every new operator trained means faster response times, more hands and feet on the ground, and more lives touched by the Gospel. We have 35 candidates committed to our next Indoc on April 9th. From self-defense and tactics, to field craft and survival, to personal and community security to surveillance and OSINT analysis, they will be run through the gamut. [**And your gift, right now, will ensure they’re equipped for the next rescue, the next medical response, and the next conversation that leads someone to Christ.**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=9ced05dccad54948a523e2e3aba062a4&_e=driNpJ4mDvv-ffvZUMyxyiSpR_riIGw2tGIfMaSTrTyUNnXK-SeQgtPskKHgVM4G_XqBD4cJdvUaJHVC6oi1DRXZ-jGBZKT-SaHHLqynyZIeOQMU_oWWZFEweNyABB-QQyGdp-e_Pftw7jgS7b2KytLFWO-TR93Ie0VexJODJU-GfBRWzOZFEPpXrDvsO3Bg9hTkNvlBE-JUXKekGO-5HTG8P6x4agI4YzsGInn3sCEZr6yW0bPrZ7LGWu2gmk18405iP3hhhsiv9VUsoPnD5bIjrS2T-Ot51nKYqagNXpLMCk7SUf73oaJ_8Xly6KMNouTOXfP5bggsT5H7fDGWP7j2zy9KKHTNebvENnWvuBWlhMVVVTXolIjQ81vkGlKDS0kBZGW61Uqb5AGJkk8XC7VqVNscpPZA3bPLsKSH-qfGXwhkJeC8BToQ68eMMhSVrQIv9XOhbJJD8K5ydoLGw0orGLERto5f5frNujmIJi6QtNVuuNc2GI5Ua93P6DGQkBiSLyCZSRqzgizE6o9aMVcBOEU4pjiUCPB1idR4zSpoPey-cVxji_5LNCqmYkVPbJEqlMYd4Bl5XFB93--W7iRdgDGHYHKCbX5pV3G_bUQ%3D) Together, we can make sure that when the desperate prayer goes up, Heroes for Humanity is already there — _**because someone like you helped get them ready.**_ Thank you for standing with us. The Save Act started in April 2024 when Speaker Johnson traveled to south Florida and introduced the legislation with former president and then presidential candidate Donald Trump. It will die where most things do in DC, the US Senate. It seemed like a simple piece of legislation then and it still is today.

Voter ID, proof of citizenship and clean voter rolls is common sense, and most American's agree. In fact, it is one of the few legislative items I can remember with such an over abundance of bipartisan support among the American population. Polls consistently support overwhelming support.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.C7wq_EocEYq-WNgiFsdczutw1FPjIaJEAg9jWkGM5lQ?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=193402552)
Pew Research in August 2025 - 83% of all adults questioned believe a photo ID should be required. Rasmussen Reports in January 2025 - 77% of likely voters believe a photo ID to vote is a "reasonable measure to protect the integrity of elections." Gallup in October 2024 - 84% agreed that "requiring all voters to provide photo identification at their voting place" is the right thing to do and in that same poll 83% want proof of citizenship when registering to vote.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3ca7c33c-bbc7-45f0-90f6-be049906d1fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I remember saying in May 2024 that the Save Act will never pass in the senate where a 60-vote threshold is required. Since then, there was much talk of 'nuking the filibuster,' something I believe is a terrible political idea, probably the worst in American history and it's an idea that has since faded. Passing the Save Act with a standing or talking filibuster has been discussed, too. That's something I would love to see, but we won't. I think it would be great to see the senate function as intended and do the work.

Senate Majority Leader John Thune stated that he doesn't even have enough votes to change the rule for a standing filibuster. Ultimately, the Save Act will be brought for a vote in the senate, and it will fail. Thune says it will put the Democrats on the record, and the Republicans will use it for the upcoming midterm. I also said, since May 2024, Save's purpose for legislator's is political messaging, not actually creating a new law.

But why not?! 80% of American's want it, but about 70 senators don't. That math doesn't add up to the voter's wishes. The US is a federal constitutional representative democracy (or republic), where **citizens** elect officials to make laws and govern on their behalf. The Constitution established that, but who are members of Congress really representing?

It's clear that Congress no longer represents the people when 80% of the people want something and Congress ignores them. As comedian George Carlin said, "it's a big club and you ain't in it." The federal government and its politicians have become something the founders never intended, bloated, cumbersome, wasteful, corrupt and in the way. It's politicians, not ours, who feed corruption and waste for power, greed and corporations' lobbyists.

A quote attributed to Ben Franklin: "It's a Republic, if you can keep it." The Senates failure to pass the Save Act is a dagger of death to through the heart of this Republic. It's people? We can only be considered subjects to the crown of big government and greedy politicians. Bend your knee and kiss the ring because when the voice of the masses are ignored by those chosen to represent that voice the Republic is already lost.

Friend,

Big Tech just lost in court, and now they’re trying to hide something even bigger.
On March 25, a California jury found Meta and YouTube liable for deliberately designing their platforms to addict children. I’m calling it what it is: **proof that the Kids Online Safety Act must pass.** Any member of Congress doing Zuckerberg’s or any other tech leader’s bidding should look at that verdict and their conscience.
This case spotlights what families across the country already know: Kids are being harmed, and Big Tech only cares about their pockets. **But that’s not all they’re trying to get away with.**
While companies like Meta, Google, and Amazon race to build ginormous AI data centers across the country, they’ve silenced local officials with NDAs, making sure citizens won’t know the true cost to their communities. Some local government officials can’t even disclose the name of the company building in their very own backyard.
So what are they hiding? Since January, average household electric costs rose 10%. And if you’re unlucky enough to find yourself near a new data center, that bill could go up another 30 to 60% in the next five years, all to subsidize companies we’re told are making record profits.
I’ve personally written to public utility regulators across all 50 states demanding answers, such as transparency behind costs. But make no mistake: Big Tech is fighting back with millions in lobbying to block accountability. And if we don’t act now, they’ll continue delaying, denying, and having families pay the price.
Your support helps keep the pressure on, mobilize the public, expose their tactics, and push legislation like the Kids Online Safety Act through Congress. _[**So if you’re with me in this fight, will you chip in whatever you can today?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/128924671/612722596/-1799740860?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1452-fr-nd1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM3OTQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYWFkNGE3ZjItMDMzMi1mMTExLTlhNDgtMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=VyS-QB5yjnOWXyE-GzGs30Egrye5VFHUYr2pbaWKNjA=)_

body:
| | | Peter, Last week, the Pennsylvania Supreme Court made a major ruling that gets to the heart of what we’ve been organizing for together. For decades, Pennsylvania law treated everyone involved in a crime where someone died the same — regardless of whether they actually killed anyone or intended for someone to die. It removes the mandatory life-without-parole sentence, but it does not yet guarantee meaningful opportunities for parole. The Arizona Democratic Party and the Young Democrats of Arizona are excited to partner this year in YDAZ’s 2026 State Convention, **CAMP YDAZ** , to continue empowering and mobilizing youth all across Arizona! This weekend will bring together young organizers from across the state for training, strategy, and community-building, equipping the next generation of leaders to organize, mobilize voters, and win elections up and down the ballot — in 2026, 2028, and beyond! In a time when many events like this come with high costs, we’ve made a deliberate decision to keep CAMP YDAZ free and accessible to attendees. We want young people — especially those who are traditionally underserved and often forgotten about in political conversations, to be able to participate regardless of financial barriers. However, to be able to actualize YDAZ’s goal of having a free event, ADP and YDAZ have partnered to ask for your support! **We are currently about _$3,000 short of our goal_ , and we’re asking for your partnership to help close that gap.** Your support will help cover meals, materials, travel assistance, and the tools young organizers need to be effective — not just at this event, but in the months ahead as they knock doors, register voters, and support Democratic candidates across Arizona. Peter,
In a few days, I’ll be participating in a debate at the Yale Political Union. The topic is ending the gerontocracy — something I am obviously passionate about already.
As I’ve been prepping for the debate, I came up with an idea: asking _you_ for input.
A lot of Leaders We Deserve supporters are older people themselves, but they are just as fed up with the status quo as we are. No matter how old we are, we are finding common ground and building an intergenerational coalition to end the gerontocracy. That’s why hearing _your perspective_ about this issue is invaluable to me.
**I want to know: Why do you want to end the gerontocracy, Peter? Why are you invested in this fight to elect a new generation of bold progressive leaders?**
**[Will you take a couple minutes to fill out my survey and share your thoughts?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/survey/lwd-em-2026-yale-debate/?source=em20260406-3338&t=2&akid=3338%2E587540%2Eq99Ye6)**

I would really appreciate your feedback. It might just help me win the debate!
Thank you,
David Hogg

#### _Cliff 's Note_: The Defense Secretary's broker tried to put millions into war stocks weeks before the bombs dropped. The deal only failed on a technicality. This is the kind of story _Blue Amp Media_ exists to chase -- and David Shuster doesn't let it go. We dropped our annual price to $60 because we want this community to be accessible for all. Come join us & don't look away.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.lSXCjx_mo0UNlZfQ3lhcfAQ7v3ZV3T6VDMRYsyXUqLg?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=193012965)
* * *
_**By David Shuster**_
There are many ways for a nation to disgrace itself, but none more efficient than allowing war makers to dabble in war profiteering. If the recent allegations against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth are even half true, our nation faces not merely a scandal, but a spectacle of epic proportions.
According to the _Financial Times_ , Hegseth's broker at Morgan Stanley allegedly explored a multimillion-dollar investment in a defense-focused ETF (Exchange Traded Fund) managed by BlackRock--just weeks before President Donald Trump launched a major military campaign against Iran.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1d421027-256e-48a7-ad71-4062c54e2d19?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
In other words, a financial broker went sniffing around on Hegseth's behalf, hoping to tuck a multi-million dollar sum into a basket of defense stocks, just before Donald Trump unleashed the dogs of war against Iran.
The deal, we are told, never came to pass. That's because the Black Rock ETF was not available for Morgan Stanley clients.
The failure of the transaction is apparently exculpatory, at least in the Trump administration.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6597e8d6-f9b7-4219-9d40-155a9aa7185c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.lSXCjx_mo0UNlZfQ3lhcfAQ7v3ZV3T6VDMRYsyXUqLg?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=193012965)
* * *
A Hegseth spokesman at the Pentagon insists the whole affair is "entirely false and fabricated." Sure.
The reporting at the Financial Times was led by Paul Murphy, the news organization's investigations editor. Murphy is considered one of the finest investigative journalists in financial news. He attributed his reporting on Hegseth to three separate sources.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/79c5a494-34e9-4b7a-9712-6940c724538f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

* * *
Meanwhile, a handful of democratic senators--Elizabeth Warren, Tammy Duckworth, Richard Blumenthal, Gary Peters, and Jeff Merkley--are demanding a Congressional investigation. They have taken the quaint position that a Secretary of Defense should not behave like a man browsing a racing sheet before placing a bet.
They warn of "conflicts of interest," which is a polite way of saying that the fellow entrusted with overseeing bombs and missiles targeting Iran should not also be seeking pre-war purchases of stocks in the U.S. companies manufacturing bombs and missiles.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1af40030-e432-45dd-8e7c-c5159b3dd2f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

* * *
Civilian control of the military depends on trust. Citizens should be able to trust that decisions on war and peace are made solely based on national security--not personal enrichment. Soldiers must believe their commanders are sending them into danger for legitimate reasons, not because someone in Washington saw a favorable position in a defense ETF.
Even the perception of insider advantage erodes that trust. It feeds a long-standing and dangerous suspicion: that war benefits the powerful while ordinary Americans bear the cost. History offers too many examples of conflicts entangled with profit motives. That is precisely why strict ethics rules exist for officials like the Defense Secretary--and why any hint of violation must be treated with urgency.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bc9a6206-81c5-4b53-a41b-2784ab395475?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

* * *
Hegseth supporters are already arguing that no investment was ultimately made, and thus no harm occurred. That is an unacceptably low bar. Ethical leadership is not about avoiding technical violations. It is about avoiding conflicts altogether--real or perceived. Attempting to position oneself for potential financial gain tied to military action is incompatible with the responsibilities of the office.
If Hegseth has nothing to hide, he should welcome a full, independent inquiry. Release communications. Provide financial disclosures. Testify under oath and have the Morgan Stanley broker also testify under oath. The deal, we are told, never came to pass. That's because the Black Rock ETF was not available for Morgan Stanley clients. The failure of the transaction is apparently exculpatory, at least in the Trump administration. | | ---|---|--- A Hegseth spokesman at the Pentagon insists the whole affair is "entirely false and fabricated." Citizens should be able to trust that decisions on war and peace are made solely based on national security--not personal enrichment. Eric Swalwell voted to thank ICE after their attacks on Los Angeles. Tom Steyer made part of his fortune by investing in immigration detention centers. That’s not the type of leadership we need when our rights are under attack.

**Now that they’re running for governor, they’re trying to hide their record. Unlike them, I have nothing to hide.**

Friend, Right now, on platforms like Polymarket and Kalshi, people are placing bets on wars, on elections, and on whether foreign leaders get captured or killed. Earlier this year, someone made over $400,000 betting on Venezuela. There was even a bet on whether the American pilots shot down in Iran would be rescued. Americans are dying, and somebody's cashing out. No one should be able to profit from how many people come home in coffins, and no one should be able to place a bet on whether our democracy withstands the abuses of the Trump administration. Donald Trump is once again trying to rewrite the rules of our election process through an illegal power grab.
California is fighting back:
I filed a lawsuit challenging Trump’s recent executive order that attempts to interfere in states’ authority to run our own elections by restricting mail-in voting and voter eligibility.
We’re suing Donald Trump because this is illegal — full stop.
The U.S. Constitution clearly gives states the primary authority over elections, and gives zero authority to the President.
If you agree we need to protect our voting rights from these unconstitutional, antidemocratic, and un-American attacks from Donald Trump, please sign my petition today. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/5Hi7CoUrY06trCyhgRx1hg2]
SIGN YOUR NAME [https://secure.ngpvan.com/5Hi7CoUrY06trCyhgRx1hg2]
This executive order is just the latest in a long line of Trump’s attempts to restrict voting, fueled by his fear of losing the upcoming midterm elections and based on wholly unfounded allegations of voter fraud.
Last year, when Trump attempted to impose sweeping voting restrictions across the country with his first elections-related executive order, I sued — and we secured a preliminary injunction blocking it.
This time, Trump is directing federal agencies to build pre-approved lists of eligible voters and mail ballot recipients. He goes on to threaten elections officials with criminal prosecution for sending ballots to anyone not on those lists, and threaten states that don't comply with the loss of our federal funding.
This executive order would force states to upend our existing election systems in a matter of weeks, creating chaos and confusion right before the midterms. Which is exactly what this administration wants.
I won’t stand by while our most basic rights are trampled on. I will fight like hell in court to stop this illegal move, and I’m grateful to have you by my side while I do it.
Please, add your name today to say you’re with me. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/5Hi7CoUrY06trCyhgRx1hg2]
Trump knows that a fair election is a threat to his tenuous political power. We’re going to make sure he gets one anyway.
Thank you for speaking out with me on this critical issue.
—Rob

Iran Rejects Ceasefire, Deadline Looms

Iran rejected the latest ceasefire proposal on Monday, demanding a permanent end to the five-week war rather than a 45-day pause—as President Trump’s Tuesday-night deadline to reopen [the Strait of Hormuz](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0LFu5CAQxvGnwR0WYIztguIad3vtldYsDGsuGBCwcZSnj7yK8gDp_xrN7_t3227gg4-Pv3CgLs1tNtnNF4gF_6Np1SBUdL5gLimnTTChKJOUqS2XVDOatvHOamsscNOh5tM0jlxJwbpdI3MLDnxx0-IcU6jAcS7UwNisxmWZO6-vg0wyJQbG-NzfRzODM1YAZ-Nyn4lkELC0vmB-3oM3EBvUN5eKwd6kowt6by1XMvwhYiViPc-zP6HuPj5aivgBh49YrpSINeJZryaVYIlY5cgnLiUR6wWm32L6Q6Yvc4VAW3kemdZWwDeaHN1TOZ6f1CLY4CMSsXZF23z6EHxVE5HscYAPrw_br2d91-IrAAD__0m3jJg) closed in. A Pakistani-brokered framework called for a ceasefire and reopening of the Strait, through which about a fifth of the world’s oil supply moves. Iran’s counteroffer demanded sanctions relief, reconstruction aid, and Hormuz safe passage—conditions Trump rejected. “They made a proposal, and it’s significant. It’s not good enough,” [Trump said](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckMFuhCAURb8GdxhARWfBoht3022X5gmPGVoU8sCx6dc39hO6vLnJvTnn477cIcSwP95hQ0PVLy65JRDshJ9oa7EIBX0gzJRyWpRQmoueC71kSiWjrYtsnHHWgbQNGjmOwyB1r0TzNFKivI3W4bQOnV2l190ECm6j0N3qtW6CuQZFL7TqhJBTuw52Am-dAimG2zqxXkBEqi1hPtYYLOwVypdPZLG1aWuiedaaC-vemJqZms_zbH363vEsV8_UHMML-ZWZmisdW-YXHj-B-DPRdvzwUAgwcsgUItcNGZfPEGMoemS9eGwQ4t9X_begl1G_AQAA__8-5noK) at a White House press conference Monday. Trump’s 8 p.m. EDT Tuesday deadline threatens airstrikes on Iranian power plants and bridges if the Strait stays closed. Meanwhile, U.S. commandos executed [a daring rescue](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckDGO5CAQAF9jZ1jAYOwJCC5xNpdeaLWbtqfvMCBgzru_X80-YeOSSqX681gfwIHj8RtOcqXtq09-5QKx0F_CVpGg0s6Fckk5rVpqK6QR0q65pJoJ26p67zx6UNiTU9M0jsoaLfunMwrQgDJez6MacaRZK_TWTgQwyzv17N5CaaTVNynVPGwjzrCj16DkeN_mzkgIVNpQKL-2wAixQf23p4I0YDr74J6t5drdfnV66fRyXdewp49IV33zTi85BW6MtdMLx8qehIfC8RCFKr5IAJeTotjoydELinR-isCRqkAGAbVybeSFJ6TcOEWBcGbgI_bF-XxxCFzt1Bl5nMDhO6r9-OR_p78CAAD__429igI) of the F-15E crew from inside Iranian territory—with CIA assistance to deceive Iranian forces. ★★★
Airman Rescue an 'Easter Miracle'
**
** President Trump hailed the dramatic rescue of a missing U.S. airman from the mountains of Iran as an "[Easter Miracle](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0DGOpDAQheHTQGZUNmDYwMEmZL3phqgoF92eMdgqu4c5_qj7CBM_6XvS__-23jDEcN7_4cFO6r765NcgeAp_MNVCjIX3IJwl5bQaMFbBoMCuWVLJTHXVrXeePGpq2elpGkdtBwPtw2nLtp9go1FrnHdCjQCWBj8xTUh9G9wLhAGs6QH03G0jzbiTN6hh_LPNzQAYWWonnJ9bDIRnxfK5JyHuKB1tdI9ac2n6v41ZGrNc19Xt6fvkq7z2xiwH-4CNWao8j6wIYyxKuNCTlU_XyV5hEPUWVQ4xVcVYKos6giBFbsX5fIUYQ7FTM8D9wBDf3_XXwb6c-QkAAP__hDiAlQ)" after special operations forces pulled off what he called one of the most complex rescue missions in U.S. military history. The F-15E weapons systems officer evaded capture for nearly 48 hours behind enemy lines after his jet was shot down during Operation Epic Fury. The mission involved 155 aircraft, including bombers, fighters, and refueling tankers. The CIA ran a [deception campaign](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0DHO2zAMBeDTyJsCipFsZ_DQod7StaNBS3SiVpEESmmuX7hAL_AvnIj3Hr6f9-1OMcX8-EEvXqQfWyhhi0JZ-Bf73jxT4yMKVym1bAg4arAaxq1KaZV938wQluADGT_wYqbJOTNahOG5AIOdzHWejXXTFHZkBg8Enq9s6cZDXM5AsDDiFcDMl935mQ4fkAy42z4rC5RY-kW4vvcUPeVO7fdRxPPFl9eQlmfvtanrN4WrwvXz-Vx24dh3kn5-KFxrSbFH3xSuZ53CFez_89ZNCzf_5qYb-5KDPhS676jQzaDQ3YxxmqK8KOuY9Umj6egs-lQ54uPZNaWkK0srOXPSjQ5WuA6yhPqJKcU2TsrC40Ux_dvcvwz9Z8G_AQAA__-eeo56) to draw Iranian forces away, and War Secretary Pete Hegseth confirmed the airman's first transmitted message was: "God is good." A [retired F-16 pilot](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0DHOnDAQxfHTQOeV7WWBLSjSbPelTYmG8QCTGNua8UJy-2hzhNRPevrr9-Nr_gKOnLbvcNAkdZ1DDjMLJKGfhFWRQGlloSK55Nlb3xvbGdvPRbIWwjq7NkwBAzhsaXLD8Hi4vvO23acB3XOkBcduHFz3RFxx7QDufgHq72Rbnj6HtrO9v1vrxtvywBFWDB6cfTyXseksRJJ6EyrvJTJCqqC_1ixIN8xHG6e91qLN_VvjX41_Xdd1W_PvRJd-9sa_DgoMjX8JVRYKZjWuN4VjrkbhjxohxTcF81YDLAckNfqWk0-I5gNhdt72yNte1XCqlJQMnaCck6kCnDhtrUyhXBwjaz80nd0O4Pivr_436jn5vwEAAP__HO2Olw) told Fox News the survival highlights the intense training U.S. aviators undergo. ★★★
Trump Endorses Hilton for Governor

President Trump gave former Fox News host Steve Hilton his "COMPLETE & TOTAL ENDORSEMENT" in the California governor's race late Sunday night, shaking up the crowded [jungle primary](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2O5CAQhJ_GzrAA_05AcMlkc-mFVhsaT99gQA0z3sdfeR9hs1KVVPr0_XusD6BAcf8LBxqufnXJrcQQGf-jrcUiFPTEmDnltGqpJyEHIac1cyoZbV1V64yzDpRt0ah5Hkc1DVq2TzOgW_qb95tViNL3t15tPaJG6P3sFt2SuQ7lICfdS6mWbhvtAt46DUqOt21pBgkBuXaM-b0FshArlJdPbLGz6WiDedaaS9P_afS90ffzPDufviKe5dobfc8pUCVbrshYyGGsovL7yOKAFxaB0SUueFy9hUA-cSQQ-3tDjlATEwTBYFE8UeyMUMWePsgxccvG5ZNCoDLNzSD3Ayj8cNVfy_wY_R0AAP__k-6Msg) to replace outgoing Gov. Gavin Newsom. Hilton and Riverside County Sheriff Chad Bianco had been the top [two GOP contenders](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2O4yAYAJ8Gd47gsw12QXGNu1x7pfUZPmJu-ROQ5PVX2UfYeqQZaf7djzv64NPjL0bStbvDZnv4iqnSfzK9GcJGzlcqNZd8AAc58nnk8ig1t0KmH2Kw2hqLwgykhVLLIuQMfLi0ktOMmzrFak9wkyI3b3bbhCN1Ikzb4PVHyGcuYeJcrLdzMSs6YwEFX7ZzZTPHQLXfKpXnGbzB1LF9uVwN3UyOQ9BX76Wx6Q-DncHeL7p8CB_GYL9ypETvxmA3GAv6R2KwL6tQchWjzQmDHXt9xjK2Ti8aLx96TiMlm2ujSKkz2IeqbXn7EHyTis38EdH_FIb-62UvDd8BAAD__3KJf14), with some Republicans hoping both could advance to lock Democrats out of the general election. Trump's endorsement likely consolidates Republican support around Hilton, potentially dimming that scenario. Hilton has pledged to cut taxes, expand homeownership, and work with the Trump White House to turn the state around before the June 2 primary.
* * *

Harris Fuels 2028 Buzz

Kamala Harris heads to Al Sharpton's National Action Network convention this week, with her recent travel and rhetoric [clearly pointing toward 2028](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGO4yAQQL_G7rDwBIxTUFzjLtdeaY1hSLhggwY23v37VfYTtn7Se9L7d1tvGFM87n9xJ8strD77NTIeTP_JteoIK4XIVDiXvIKESUgl5LQWzrWQa-vYe-udx9H1ZEdjtB4nBbJ_WK_IbNqogGMIs0RNGg1MhtTVQDC-j_YtlEpOcJFynIdNuxmD84Cj1Ndt7pTERNwGpvKxpejwaFifIbOjweW9T_bRWqnd5U8HSwfLeZ5DyJ8HnfXNO1hKTrFFVztYnrhjQvFA5lhFY3xRqsLlfaejVeESIacvUXI8mgAJc8_WlzOmFOtkOiXvO8b0022_nvWy8B0AAP__cs9-sg), per Fox News.

★★★

Democrats running for Senate in Michigan are split over appearing in public with [Hasan Piker](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0LFu6yAUgOGnwRsRYLDJwHAXb7lrR-v4cIhpsEFAG-Xtq_QROv_SN_wft_UGMcXz_h8OcrWH1We_xgpnpU_C3pCgUYiVSs0lr0qoiQvNxbSWmlsh7KscvPPoQeJATs6zMXLSSgy7C1c9B0Jh7XXcDHqPJgCYiUYxalB6iO4NCi0mNQoh7WUzaCGgVyCFuW6WaQGJar9UKl9bighnh_YIuSJdMB9DcnvvpbHxH1MLU0vfaY8pvRtTy54POunZmFoQjgLxfjK1GCvNbA2nxBu8yPMKKb14iQ-qfAN8JGg7U8tQnS_PmFJs08y0uB8Qf-Wh_3nVt1M_AQAA__-IvHwK), a radical left YouTube streamer who declared that America "deserved" 9/11.

A few years ago, I looked around and asked myself:

_Why are so many young women exhausted, anxious, and numb?_

Why do they feel betrayed by their bodies?

Why are they medicated into submission by 19... and afraid to admit they want marriage and motherhood?

**And how -- HOW -- did the Left convince them this was empowerment? **

The truth is, they didn't sell them freedom...

_They sold them bondage with a designer label. _

"Girlboss" feminism.

They told them the cure for their confusion was more pills... more dependency... more government... more Leftism.

That the antidote... _was more poison. _

This isn't accidental.

The Left built a system that breaks women -- and then sells them more brokenness to "fix" it.

Exploitation dressed up as "liberation."

But I don't believe women are broken... _or hopelessly lost to the Left... _

I just believe they've been lied to.

**And that 's why Turning Point USA's Women's Leadership Summit 2026 (WLS) matters now more than ever. **

**Because it 's more than a conference... It's a mass detox for America's young women: **

✅ Detox from the Left's propaganda.
✅ Detox from big food & big pharma lies.
✅ Detox from moral & cultural confusion.
✅ Detox from emotional numbness -- the kind I know personally, because I lived it.

I was on SSRIs (antidepressants).

I was sold the same pills, the same promises, the same "girlboss" trap.

And I got out.

I weaned off the meds. I reset my health. I embraced my femininity.

And I want other young women to know they can, too.

Because this isn't just about health...

It's about reclaiming your mind, your home, your faith. And your country.

**And that 's what this year's Women's Leadership Summit is all about -- reclaiming America's daughters from the lies the Left sold them.**

From June 5-7 in San Antonio, thousands of women will gather to:

🔥 Reclaim their God-given design
🔥 Step out of survival mode
🔥 Embrace truth without fear
🔥 Find purpose in faith, family, and freedom

And the lineup of speakers this year so far?

Trust me -- these are America's boldest, most beautiful truth-tellers:

clean_body: | | | | | Peter, A few years ago, I looked around and asked myself: Why are so many young women exhausted, anxious, and numb? Why do they feel betrayed by their bodies? Why are they medicated into submission by 19... and afraid to admit they want marriage and motherhood? And how -- HOW -- did the Left convince them this was empowerment? The truth is, they didn't sell them freedom... They sold them bondage with a designer label. "Girlboss" feminism. They told them the cure for their confusion was more pills... more dependency... more government... more Leftism. That the antidote... was more poison. This isn't accidental. The Left built a system that breaks women -- and then sells them more brokenness to "fix" it. Exploitation dressed up as "liberation." But I don't believe women are broken... or hopelessly lost to the Left... I just believe they've been lied to. And that 's why Turning Point USA's Women's Leadership Summit 2026 (WLS) matters now more than ever. Because it 's more than a conference... It's a mass detox for America's young women: ✅ Detox from the Left's propaganda. ✅ Detox from big food & big pharma lies. ✅ Detox from moral & cultural confusion. ✅ Detox from emotional numbness -- the kind I know personally, because I lived it. I was on SSRIs (antidepressants). I was sold the same pills, the same promises, the same "girlboss" trap. And I got out. I weaned off the meds. I reset my health. I embraced my femininity. And I want other young women to know they can, too. Because this isn't just about health... It's about reclaiming your mind, your home, your faith. And your country. And that 's what this year's Women's Leadership Summit is all about -- reclaiming America's daughters from the lies the Left sold them. From June 5-7 in San Antonio, thousands of women will gather to: 🔥 Reclaim their God-given design 🔥 Step out of survival mode 🔥 Embrace truth without fear 🔥 Find purpose in faith, family, and freedom And the lineup of speakers this year so far? Trust me -- these are America's boldest, most beautiful truth-tellers: They aren't coming to coddle. They're coming to call these girls UP. Because the young women who will walk into WLS 2026 will hear something they 've never been told before: You are not broken. You are not oppressed. You are not crazy for loving God and loving America. You are not crazy for wanting to be married and to have children. You are powerful. You, as a woman, hold the keys to healing our sick culture -- and restoring our country. Because if we're going to win the culture war, we start at home. With women rooted in truth. Charlie knew this, too... He cracked the code with America's young men. They're shifting towards conservatism in record numbers. High school boys are the most conservative they've been in five decades. But the battle isn't over... Because if we don 't reach the girls? We don't win the homes. We don't win their children. We don't win the future. And that 's why we need your help today, Peter... Every year, many young women want to attend WLS, but don't have the resources to get there... For many of them, a $50 sponsorship is the difference between staying home -- or stepping into their calling. Let me tell you what your gift does today: It doesn 't just get a young woman into the room for WLS 2026... It gives her permission -- and power -- to live differently. It doesn't just punch her ticket... It shapes her future. She goes back to campus bold. She speaks truth in hostile classrooms. She gets married and builds a strong home. She raises children who love God and love America. One woman influences: Her husband. Her children. Her friends. Her church. Her neighborhood. Her school board. Multiply that by thousands... And that's how our culture is healed. That's how our country is restored. You're not just helping her break free from the lies... You're helping her step into her calling -- As a future wife. A future mother. A future leader in the American revival. Let's make sure the young women who are ready to lead... get the chance to do it. Please help send them to San Antonio this summer. Because this is how we break the Left's grip on America's women. This is how we win the culture war. One fearless young woman at a time. | | For Charlie, Alex Clark Host, Culture Apothecary For Turning Point USA P.S. Help raise up the next generation of faith-filled, freedom-loving women who will rebuild this country from the inside out. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044 |

name: Morgan Stahr, United for Democracy
subject: Congress must stop this power grab now
disclaimer_text: Paid for by United for Democracy
body:
Trump signed an executive order attempting to take over our elections. It's unconstitutional, dangerous, and we have to stop it before it’s too late. | |
---
Peter, **Trump just signed an executive order attempting to rewrite voting rules ahead of the 2026 midterm elections, giving himself the power to reject millions of ballots.** The order is a massive attack on our voting rights and an incredible abuse of presidential power. The order directs the Department of Homeland Security and the Social Security Administration to compile a federal list of "verified" citizens, and would force the United States Postal Service to refuse delivery of ballots to anyone not on that list. **If this order is allowed to stand, it would give Trump the power over elections that states are meant to have, and could suppress millions of legitimate votes.** **This is how the wealthy and powerful steal power from working people so that only their voice matters, not ours.** The wannabe dictator is trying to entrench MAGA power by tipping the scales against the very communities that turn out in force when voting is accessible. **United for Democracy is mobilizing our allies, activists, experts, and all the issue organizations in our coalition to demand immediate action. If the Executive Branch won't protect the people, Congress must.** [**The Constitution gives states the power to administer elections—not Donald Trump. Tell Congress to reject this executive overreach and pass legislation that protects access to the ballot before it’s too late.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm396MCpkY7Ue0aOf7CTWHOaxb4t0bZnMkKuRpDrcw-GGlOjxXYw3nkHOuvdOqSoWXQ5a_bey_ozOhNBXhgTwASFJsOEJpLom1nJBLJLcjlTSQEN7P6w5mGrgWQMy3xS051wdTT385OkHnBZyDE-ko1vFTmTVJ5cMl3o2YR1UXAB7Pk6jcBdquSi5-nz7UXn-vXwjiKBxuvI8KkoxKP5z6nkaPe-9PlPLFIb1oPHDcx0sGa_c0YnPvjNOpIW0riQB3vVtWPPEc9EfVfvnxHrVW0tzCAGlhHytuIeRB7M9d_5k9HzzPWbrGEckcioYHhYO-q1h__ngzH8HjPKymaarXY7f9raLJ6zPahu5WKWmjpASCyR8bs17VxxJ0Wmr-s_NXadIWO42c9QrYrkGDyAFMJ--/4pk/GKIGLHOLTLGGacWhRi9MBA/h0/h001.VEQCEiyPTrIhxu5ePbCfikd8xH9d4pruN2vOW6G_IpA) [SIGN & SEND](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm396MCpkY7Ue0aOf7CTWHOaxb4t0bZnMkKuRpDrcw-GGlOjxXYw3nkHOuvdOqSoWXQ5a_bey_ozOhNBXhgTwASFJsOEJpLom1nJBLJLcjlTSQEN7P6w5mGrgWQMy3xS051wdTT385OkHnBZyDE-ko1vFTmTVJ5cMl3o2YR1UXAB7Pk6jcBdquSi5-nz7UXn-vXwjiKBxuvI8KkoxKP5z6nkagQ6kPSk0NCEM_A_Ym3_YkEM6BaWu6eGqHqQXoE-a0Q4wehAfKoS0g2UNMTjaYmZqP8kTzbvP6ITt2UpA5-1gMQu4xwO7UdhqxuGp5yHZ-mkDz2pQ8Tw3DyuMu6ATNUKpiU1fzfMRkiQkwgML-Zebyfvwf2ycL-FlDlAs55C-O_ov_OHgri1SnuTjxaTxCm6a/4pk/GKIGLHOLTLGGacWhRi9MBA/h1/h001.RfuHgJEUHoLS6-VGFvWqZJ9CmlaYz-mM4vXooymqL2c) **Trump has told Republicans they will lose the midterms unless they crack down on mail-in voting.** He is openly admitting that this is a partisan power grab designed to keep his party in control—regardless of the will of the people. We cannot let this stand. Massachusetts Attorney General Andrea Joy Campbell has already promised legal action, and the NAACP declared this order "unserious" and unconstitutional. **But legal challenges take time, and Trump is counting on delays to block enforcement until after November.** We also know the bought-and-paid for Supreme Court will likely side with Trump if any lower courts dare rule against him. That’s why we need Congress to defend voting rights right now. **This isn't just about mail-in voting; it's about whether we remain a democracy or slide into authoritarian rule for decades to come.** We’re building the mass movement to fight back against these wealthy extremists and corrupt politicians and justices. **But we need your voice in that fight right now if we want Congress to listen to us instead of the elites pulling the strings.** [**Write to your members of Congress immediately. Tell them that America is watching, and we demand they protect our voting rights.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm396MCpkY7Ue0aOf7CTWHOaxb4t0bZnMkKuRpDrcw-GGlOjxXYw3nkHOuvdOqSoWXQ5a_bey_ozOhNBXhgTwASFJsOEJpLom1nJBLJLcjlTSQEN7P6w5mGrgWQMy3xS051wdTT385OkHnBZyDE-ko1vFTmTVJ5cMl3o2YR1UXAB7Pk6jcBdquSi5-nz7UXn-vXwjiKBxuvI8KkoxKP5z6nkaM_MYLPPo1VhGOUiT7flzf8WUDvIyG8yWYJFlFfrTCMmfrTczQJxws7vWVaOGDhk_AXdRbtQ4rZvOr8uI3AP1ROJq9LU1xPWdKhbYgOu8YA_1TZgMJnI8u4Rrb-6bdtdWLd7nQ6IjoLNUEyzFhX3d9nvabL_iHx9SLXJQlsQlso4uYyliUq_lN0C9Btf2lenB/4pk/GKIGLHOLTLGGacWhRi9MBA/h2/h001.mavZ2UMOfhW3Sm8xSoRNxPk_kjzXGLoHsQJOLrMC3Uo) Thank you for fighting for birthright citizenship, Morgan Stahr

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: Trump wants a permanent underclass.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
The Department of Justice just argued in favor of ending birthright citizenship in front of the Supreme Court.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260406-6102-footer&t=1&akid=6102%2E420207%2EEZKasj)
Peter,
Donald Trump just shattered hundreds of years of precedent. He showed up at the Supreme Court as his own DOJ argued to strip birthright citizenship from the children of undocumented immigrants.
No sitting president has observed arguments in person. It blurs the lines between the branches of government and applies abusive pressure from the highest office in the country.
**But here’s the thing: the 14th Amendment couldn’t be clearer. If you’re born in the United States, you are a citizen. Period.**
That’s not a policy that Trump can overturn with an executive order. It’s the Constitution — and no wannabe king can change that.
This fight isn’t just politics for me. It’s personal. I came to this country alone at 16 years old, unsure what my future would hold. And it gave me the chance to live my American dream: becoming an organizer, an immigrant rights advocate, and eventually a member of Congress fighting for working people.
It’s sickening to watch powerful politicians, backed by dark money billionaires, as they attempt to slam the door shut on immigrants. **They want to create a permanent underclass: people born here but denied citizenship and all its benefits like education, jobs, and health care.**
That is unacceptable.
This moment matters. It’s essential we ensure that EVERY person who calls this country home is treated with dignity. And that means we must keep building a people-powered movement strong enough to fight back against Trump’s authoritarian agenda.
And Peter, I can’t do it without you. I don’t take corporate PAC money, and I don’t seek out billionaires to use as ATMs. This campaign runs on grassroots supporters like you, pitching in a few bucks at a time.
**So if you believe that everyone deserves the same chance I had — and in a Constitution where _everyone_ born in the United States is a citizen — [will you pitch in $3 or whatever you can today to help us keep building this movement?](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260406.otWx1C&refcode=em20260406-6102&amount=3&t=2&akid=6102%2E420207%2EEZKasj)**
**[Contribute $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260406.otWx1C&amount=3&refcode=em20260406-6102&t=21&akid=6102%2E420207%2EEZKasj)**
In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal

name: Judicial Watch Tipsheet
subject: Judicial Watch Uncovers FBI Records Showing FBI Objections to Planned Mar-a-Lago Raid
body:
Judicial Watch announced that it has obtained 207 pages of Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) records that reveal the FBI’s concerns about the legal basis for the raid of then-former President Donald J. Trump’s Mar-a-Lago home. The records expose deep concerns within the FBI itself, including explicit objections from field agents who warned the U.S. Department of Justice that the unprecedented August 8, 2022, raid on Trump’s home lacked probable cause.

Peter,

As we approach the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence, I’ve been thinking a lot about the courage of our Founding Fathers.

250 years ago, 56 patriots risked everything — their lives, their fortunes, and their sacred honor — to create the greatest country the world has ever seen. A nation founded on liberty, opportunity, and the God-given rights we still cherish today.

That same spirit of patriotism is what called me to service. **On my 18th birthday in October 2001, just weeks after 9/11, I joined the Marine Corps and later became a Navy SEAL.** I deployed nine times to over 70 countries, risking my life to defend the Constitution and the American way of life my parents taught me to love.

Today, as a proud Minnesotan running for the U.S. Senate, I’m fighting to protect that same legacy. But while Republicans continue standing for the core values that built Minnesota and America — strong families, secure borders, safe streets, free enterprise, and real opportunity — _**the Democratic Party has been overtaken by something completely unrecognizable.**_

While our communities were expressing serious concerns and _bipartisan opposition_ to these detention centers, he wasn't listening. He wasn't answering our questions. He wasn't standing up for us.
**He was enabling them. He was secretly working with DHS to make sure these inhumane 7,500+ bed mega-jails come to our rural communities.**
Let's be extra clear, because Meuser isn't getting the message. These facilities do not work here. We do not want them.
The Tremont detention center will require 900,000 gallons of water a day. There already isn't enough water in the ground for the people who live there. They're trucking it in. With this facility, they'll have to send in 150 poop trucks a day just to haul the sewage out. The roads can't handle that.
I'll repeat it again, just in case Meuser is listening to a constituent for once in his career: These facilities do not belong here. They're cruel, they're wrong, and they don't make sense. **They do not work in PA-09, and we do not want them.**

Rachel Wallace

name: The Democrats
subject: The choice is ours
body:
---
Derek, With less than seven months to go until this year’s midterm elections, Trump and his Republican allies are trying their hardest to overwhelm us. They know _exactly_ how much is at stake this year, and they’re relying on our silence to win the midterms and maintain their power. **We have two options for our future:** **Option A:** We give in. We let Republicans scare us into complacency and they maintain their majorities in the House and the Senate, leaving Trump’s power unchecked by Congress for the next two years of his presidency. **Option B:** We use their chaotic, destructive agenda as motivation to _keep fighting_. We win back the House and the Senate and put a major check on Trump’s power. And we help down-ballot Democrats across the country win their races so they can protect their communities from Trump’s agenda as well. **Derek, we don’t want to wake up on November 4 feeling like we didn’t do enough to win this year, and we suspect that you don’t either. So we’re choosing Option B, and[**we hope you’ll join us.****](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-april-2026?refcode=em_20260406_6633_fr&amount=7&refcode2=6633_22930333_rPYNyE&akid=6633%2E22930333%2ErPYNyE) The DNC is working around the clock to organize across the country, register new Democratic voters, and provide state parties and campaigns with the resources they need to win this year — _because we know what’s at stake._ But none of this work is possible without the help of grassroots supporters just like you. clean_body: Derek, With less than seven months to go until this year’s midterm elections, Trump and his Republican allies are trying their hardest to overwhelm us. They know exactly how much is at stake this year, and they’re relying on our silence to win the midterms and maintain their power. We have two options for our future: Option A: We give in. We let Republicans scare us into complacency and they maintain their majorities in the House and the Senate, leaving Trump’s power unchecked by Congress for the next two years of his presidency. Option B: We use their chaotic, destructive agenda as motivation to keep fighting. We win back the House and the Senate and put a major check on Trump’s power. And we help down-ballot Democrats across the country win their races so they can protect their communities from Trump’s agenda as well. Derek, we don’t want to wake up on November 4 feeling like we didn’t do enough to win this year, and we suspect that you don’t either. So we’re choosing Option B, and The DNC is working around the clock to organize across the country, register new Democratic voters, and provide state parties and campaigns with the resources they need to win this year — because we know what’s at stake. But none of this work is possible without the help of grassroots supporters just like you.
